name: Flexoki Dark
_comment: Flexoki-matched Claude Code theme, contrast-tuned for terminals that render
SGR 2 (faint) by halving the foreground.
WHY THE ODD-LOOKING CHOICES: Claude Code hard-codes dimColor:true on option
descriptions in AskUserQuestion / any Select list, ON TOP of an explicit
truecolor foreground (color = 'success' when selected, 'suggestion' when
focused). There is no setting to disable it. So every token that can land
under a description must still clear ~4.5:1 on the background AFTER halving.
That is why suggestion is blue-200 and success is green-200 rather than the
400-series values you would otherwise reach for.
Measured against #1C1B1A — the ACTUAL background of WezTerm's builtin
flexoki-dark scheme (base-950), not Flexoki's nominal black #100F0F. That
one step up the ramp costs ~0.7 of ratio and is the difference between
several of these passing and failing, so measure against what renders.
Contrast on #1C1B1A, plain / after linear-halved dim:
text       #cecdc3  10.77 / 5.79
inactive   #b7b5ac   8.37 / 4.59
subtle     #9f9d96   6.34 / 3.58   (built-in dark was 2.11 / 1.50)
suggestion #92bfdb   8.76 / 4.81   (built-in dark was 9.16 / 2.65 sRGB-dim)
success    #bec97e   9.70 / 5.26
warning    #dfb431   8.77 / 4.79
Recompute with agent-core/claude-themes/check-contrast.py after any edit.
Pairs with the intensity='Half' font rule in agent-core/wezterm/wezterm.lua,
which must NOT use a Light weight or the dim text loses stem weight too.
